about: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B (NVIDIA 24 GB GGUF: IQ2_XXS experts, NVFP4 Mamba, Q8_0 attention) on SYCL (official server-intel image, build 11681 / 5e03a1ff, the first with Bolt support), Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB: all layers and the image projector on the GPU, flash attention on, batch and micro-batch 2048, 262,144 context, one slot
setup: Requires one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB and 25 GB of disk for the GGUF and its image projector; the whole model sits in VRAM, so host RAM barely matters (the GGUF is memory-mapped). Upstream llama.cpp server-intel image build 11681 (commit 5e03a1ff), the first SYCL build with Nemotron 3.5 Bolt support (llama.cpp cd0a5b6a). Context 262,144 tokens in one slot (--parallel 1: more slots split the context). The LiLiCorr speculative drafter is not supported by llama.cpp (0 of 2,877 drafts accepted as a draft-simple model) and n-gram speculation gave no gain on the protocol's prompts, so neither is used. Measured on omarchy (EPYC 7443P, PCIe 4.0 x16) with the local-ai-recipe-kit sweep (--api llamacpp): prefill 731 / 736 / 728 / 707 tok/s at 8K / 16K / 32K / 64K; decode 26.2 / 26.1 / 26.1 / 26.1 tok/s at 1-4 users (one slot), C1 at 32K 24.6; needle 242,176 tokens at depth 0.8 pass. Vision: images through the NVIDIA mmproj.
